title: ICT Register — Data Quality
subtitle: The workbook's 52 continuous data-quality checks, computed live over the register

filters.label: Every check has threshold 0: any violating row is a finding

status.not_measurable_hint: The app does not track this check's inputs yet, so it cannot fire on production data.
